description:
**掌中鲸 (DSH Remote)** lets you view and control the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) AI agent running on your computer, right from your iPhone — in meetings, on the go, or in bed.

**Features:**
- **Sessions at a glance**: Browse full conversation history, follow AI progress in real time, send messages, or interrupt tasks anytime
- **Approval center**: Approve or deny tool-call requests and answer agent questions with one tap
- **Goals board**: Create, pause, resume, and complete agent goals at a glance
- **Background tasks**: Monitor workflow and subagent status and output
- **Zero-config pairing**: Scan the QR code shown by the computer companion app to connect instantly — no manual setup
- **Instant notifications**: Get notified on approval requests, questions, and errors

**Security**: Pairing keys stay on your device; all communication uses token authentication, and your computer's DSH port is never exposed to the local network.
keywords: deepseek, harness, dsh, ai agent, remote control, chat, approval, task, workflow, codex
